intro.title: 5 Mukhi (Face) Java Rudraksha
intro.descriptionHtml:
The 5 Mukhi Rudraksha brings peace of mind, overall well-being and enhances self-awareness. This rudraksha bead connect us to our higher self, or UpaGuru, sharpening our intellect, wisdom, and knowledge while keeping us focused by uplifting our conscious experience. This is a protective and awakening rudraksha very suitable for those starting the spiritual path.

As per Shiv Puran, 5 Mukhi Rudraksha is Rudra Himself. It is important to note that the vast majority of Rudraksha malas in the world are made from Java, Indonesian 5 Mukhi rudraksha beads. At Rudra Centre, these malas are strung according to RRST in order to unleash their full potential.

tabs.tab1_description:
5 Mukhi Javanese Rudraksha is the most abundantly available rudraksha bead. The 5 Mukhi rudraksha bead symbolizes Lord Kalagni Rudra, one of the fierce manifestations of Lord Shiva which makes the wearer to get rid of this life karma.

In Vedic Astrology, the 5 Mukhi Rudraksha is associated with Jupiter which makes five Mukhi to be a guiding bead in our path, by providing the knowledge we need. The wearer of this Rudraksha is cleansed of their sins, realigned with their life's purpose, granted their wishes, and reaches a state of happiness in their lives. This is the most popular rudraksha bead utilized in the creation of wearable malas. Given that it is abundantly available from Shakti or Mother Earth as it is the most produced Mukhi rudraksha bead from nature, it appears that Lord Shiva wanted it to be worn by humans in order to elevate their awareness.

Popularly known as Paanch Mukhi Rudraksh, it also symbolizes de 5 forms of Shiva the Supreme, which represent the 5 elements of nature, namely Ishana, Tatpurusha, Aghora, Vamadeva and Sadyojatha. Lord Kalagni Rudra destroys sins of devotees thereby purifying them and enabling them to complete their entire life cycle.

This rudraksha creates a protective cocoon around the wearer so he or she is safe from negative influences. It is worn around the neck by children in the Gurukul system (Indian traditional educational system between guru and its students) for guru guidance and protection. Panchmukhi rudraksha original bead or five Mukhi rudraksha is also the most extensively used for chanting mantras, japa and yoga practices, and invoking all gods and goddesses.

Scriptural Reference of 5 Mukhi Rudraksha

Shiva Purana. Chapter 25, Slokas 69-70.

Panchavaktrah svayam rudrah kala-agnir namatah prabhu | 
Sarvamuktipradashchaiva sarvakamafalapradah || 69 ||
Five faced Rudraksha is the form of Lord Kala-agni Rudra. This Rudraksha delivers all liberation and fulfills all wishes. 

 

Agamyagamanam papamabhakshayasya cha bhakshanam |
Ityadisarvapapani panchavaktro vyapohati || 70 ||
Sins arising from adultery and consuming uneatable foods are rinsed by five faced Rudraksha 

Padma Purana, Chapter 57

पञ्चवक्त्रं तु रुद्राक्षं कालाग्निं पापनाशनम्।

Translation: The five-faced Rudraksha is Kalagni, destroyer of sins.

5 Mukhi Java Rudraksha is available in a variety of sizes, including: small, regular, large and collector. The bigger the size of the rudraksha the faster the results. This is because the seeds are bigger and the surface area in contact with skin is larger, thus, energy is dispersed more quickly throughout the body.

Nevertheless, the 5 Mukhi Java Rudraksha is best worn as a 108+1 beads regular size mala on the chest, because this creates a powerful energy circuit in contact with a larger part of the body, and its energy is better dispersed through its sumeru bead resulting in a higher and faster healing potential and superior effectiveness than wearing a single 5 Mukhi bead alone.

  • It speeds up the attainment of the life purpose disclosed in the birth chart by removing negativity and enhancing awareness.

5 Mukhi Rudraksha Price from Java, Indonesia

Although the price of any Rudraksha depends on its rarity, Rudra Centre offers authentic 5 mukhi Rudraksha from Java at an affordable price. Since it is an agricultural product the harvest of any season determines the price and this can vary from season to season. Rudra Centre sources all our Rudraksha directly from farmers in Java, our beads undergo a strict selection process where the size, health, weight and many other relevant parameters of the rudraksha are analysed, since we are the biggest suppliers of Java Rudraksha in the world, we are able to provide the best quality Rudraksha at the most reasonable five mukhi rudraksha price to our customers. Indeed, we offer the best price of panch mukhi rudraksha.

As per our research bigger sized beads work faster. Bigger sized beads are rarer, so they are higher priced than smaller sized beads. As per the size of the bead, the Javanese 5 mukhi rudraksha is classified into small, regular, large & collector. These factors will determine the final 5 face rudraksha price.

The original 5 mukhi Rudraksha price from Java or Indonesian Panchmukhi rudraksha price ranges between INR 20 – INR 60 (USD 0.25 – USD 0.75) depending on their size. There may be some unique well-formed big sized 5 mukhi Javanese Rudraksha beads which come under the Super Collector variety which are priced as per their rarity.

There is another variety of 5 mukhi Java which are primarily used in Malas and Bracelets which are called 5 mukhi Malas or Bracelets. We offer a variety of these 5 mukhi java malas strung in different lengths in regular, semi Chikna and Chikna varieties, and also with gemstones such as Amethyst, Pearl or Sphatik, as well as bracelets too. These small Mukhi Mala beads are ideally for making jewellery and for Japa - Keeping count of Mantra Chanting. The price of these malas ranges from INR 1850 – INR 12,900 (USD 23.13 – USD 161.25) depending on their sizes, length, gemstones and variety. Chikna 5 mukhi Javanese rudraksha is of higher quality, has a smoother surface, and is denser, so malas made from multiple Panchmukhi rudraksha chikna or semi chikna beads are an exceptional variety.

Difference Between 5 mukhi Java & 5 mukhi Nepal

While the internal structure of both 5 mukhi from Java and Nepal is identical, the outer structure differs, 5 mukhi Nepal is bigger with deeper grooves or Mukhi lines and is more thorny with several projections whereas 5 mukhi Java are smaller, with thread like Mukhi lines which are not deep and have smoother surface.

Both beads emit same frequency and work on the same principles, in other words, both are 5 mukhi rudraksha original beads. The only difference is in the intensity of the frequency emitted because Nepali 5 mukhi is larger in size when compared to 5 mukhi Java. Therefore 5 mukhi Nepal works faster than 5 mukhi Java. Note that experience of the effects of Rudraksha is also a subjective experience however feedback from clients over 20 years have shown that Nepali beads work faster than Javanese beads. Long term effects of both beads are similar as the Chakra gets balanced due to resonance. The 5 mukhi Nepalese beads usually take 2-3 days to achieve resonance with the body whereas 5 mukhi Javanese beads take up to 10 – 12 days, during this time the thoughts process becomes clear and streamlined, however measurable results are experienced over months of usage.

Also, the price of Nepali 5 mukhi is higher than Javanese 5 mukhi because the firstly the demand for Nepali beads is higher than Javanese beads, also Javanese beads yields is much higher than Nepali beads that means more Java beads are produced in an year than Nepali beads hence the price of 5 mukhi Java Indonesia is lower than 5 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha.

While Nepalese beads are striking eye-catching in appearance due to its larger size, prominent thorns and shadowy deep grooves, making them generally more appealing for encasing in stunning silver or gold bracelets, Java beads are generally more suitable for intricated combinations with gemstones of smaller size and for threading malas and other accessories such as mats or meditation hats. Likewise, while Nepal beads are round shaped, Java beads are collected in a variety of geometric shapes.

Finally, it is an individual’s preference of whether he wants to wear 5 mukhi from Nepal or from Java Indonesia. Some like the power, intensity and deep grooves of Nepali beads whereas some prefer Javanese beads as they can be converted into beautiful jewellery such as rings and earrings due to their smaller size, and are more comfortable to wear on the body due to their soft touch, and can be covered easily.
tabs.tab3_description:
Who Should wear 5 mukhi Rudraksha from Java, Indonesia?

The 5 mukhi Java rudraksha is suitable for everyone, and particularly beneficial for those suffering any of the ailments mentioned above, and those who need to reawaken themselves, for instance those already engaged in meditation and spiritual sadhana.

The Indonesian 5 mukhi or Panchmukhi Java rudraksha improves well-being and optimizes the individual's entire energetic system by bringing a natural layer of protection against all forms of negativity and increased awareness.

Therefore, the five mukhi Java rudraksha from Indonesia is an essential rudraksha that should be worn by everyone and also in combination with other mukhi rudraksha beads or gemstones to enhance their effectiveness while strung as per Rudraksha Ratna Chakra Therapy or RRCT methodology if worn as malas or combinations in bracelets, in order to reap their maximum potential.

How to wear 5 mukhi Rudraksha from Java, Indonesia?

It can be worn as a mala, pendant or a bracelet as per Rudraksha Ratna Chakra Therapy (RRCT). To obtain 100 percent results from a 5 mukhi Java Rudraksha, it must be worn in accordance with RRCT; for guidance, CLICK HERE to consult our experts.

Preferably, one should wear 5 mukhi Java beads in the form of a Mukhi Mala or Bracelet. The stringing of 5 mukhi rudraksha beads in the Mukhi Mala or Bracelet is crucial for maintaining the energy circuit. According to our patented Rudraksha Ratna Chakra Therapy (RRCT), which harnesses the full potential of 5 mukhi beads, Rudra Centre strings multiple 5 mukhi beads in a manner which taps the 100% power of 5 mukhi Javanese rudraksha from Indonesia.

Which day to start wearing the 5 mukhi Rudraksha from Java, Indonesia?

Before shipping it to you, Rudra Centre will energise your 5 mukhi Java Rudraksha so that it can be worn immediately, nevertheless; Thursdays are also ideal for wearing or beginning to wear a 5 mukhi Java Rudraksha.

How long does it take for 5 mukhi Java Indonesian Rudraksha to start working?

If worn according to RRCT, the 5 mukhi Java Rudraksha will resonate with your body within 10 - 12 days of continuous wearing. You will notice that your emotional and mental processes become more streamlined, and you will feel considerably more at ease. Depending on the individual's sensitivity to rudraksha, you will see quantifiable results after a few days, or in the case of ingrained issues and deep rooted blockages, weeks or months of continuous use will result in a more balanced Manipura chakra.

How to energize the 5 mukhi Rudraksha Java Indonesian Rudraksha?

Rudra Centre performs the Pran Prathistha energizing procedure of your 5 mukhi Javanese rudraksha before shipping it to you, so you already receive it energized.

If you do not wear your 5 mukhi rudraksha bead for more than 2 weeks it will go into “sleep mode”. After this point you can wear it again and it will take 2 weeks to activate and another 10 - 12 days to get into resonance with your body.

According to RRCT, if you wear a 5 mukhi Java Rudraksha 24 hours a day, seven days a week, you do not need to re-energise it, therefore you may wear it when sleeping. A re-energizing method would be required only after lengthy durations of not wearing the bead after getting it from us. In this scenario, you may do regular energization or Pran Prathistha of rudraksha on your own, or you can visit a nearby temple and have a priest perform the energization for you.

The detailed procedure of Rudraksha Puja Vidhi is described HERE

Rules to Wear 5 mukhi Java Indonesian Rudraksha

The energy of the Rudraksha is in its seeds, so ensure that the Rudraksha you are wearing has no cracks. While external surface fractures are permissible (but should be avoided), there should be no fissures that reach the seeds, which must be fully intact.

Ensure that the rudraksha beads you are wearing are healthy and are not infested with insects or molds.

Anyone regardless of their gender, caste, religion or age can wear Rudraksha, women can wear rudraksha during their menstrual cycle as well.

Ensure your 5 mukhi Rudraksha is energized before wearing it. As mentioned, if you purchase 5 mukhi Java Rudraksha from Rudra Centre it will be energized before shipping so you can wear it immediately.

According to RRCT, Rudraksha should be worn 24 hours a day, seven days a week, even while sleeping; therefore, if you wear it continuously, you do not need to reenergize it.

If you have not worn the Rudraksha in a long time you can follow the steps mentioned above, reenergize, and wear it.

There are no dietary restrictions associated with wearing Rudraksha, such as abstinence from alcohol and meat. Naturally, after a lengthy period of wearing Rudraksha, our body adapts to a more sattvic diet in accordance with Rudraksha's vibrations. The full potential of seven mukhi rudraksha beads can be realized at that time or earlier if a sattvic diet is adhered to, although this is not required.

On Thursdays, you can place 5 mukhi Java rudraksha bead or mala on an altar near to a Shivalingam and chant its beej mantra “Om Hreem Namah” or “Om Namah Shivay” while offering some incense fumes. This practice enhances your alignment with the energy field of the 5 mukhi Javanese rudraksha.

It is advised to remove Rudraksha while visiting a cemetery or during the death of a family member or while performing Shraadh rituals (Last Rites).

Do not share your Rudraksha beads with others and if you wish to donate it to someone else make sure to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it.

You may wear Rudraksha while engaging in physical intimacy with your partner, but if it makes you feel uncomfortable, you may remove it during this period.

You can wear Rudraksha in toilet or washroom, but it is advisable to be cautious about soaps and shower gels adhering to the beads. If this occurs then rinse them with water as soon as possible. However, it is recommended to briefly remove the Rudraksha combination so that soap or other chemicals do not become trapped in the Rudraksha's grooves.

It is critical to keep your 5 mukhi java rudraksha from drying out due to weather conditions such as cold or dry climates, as this can cause surface level cracks. To prevent this it is advisable to apply any natural unscented oil like Sandal Oil, Olive Oil or Cow Ghee from time to time.

Rudraksha darkens overtime with usage as it absorbs oils, heat, sweat and dirt from the environment. It will turn from sandy brown to dark brown. If proper care is taken it will last for generations to come.
tabs.tab4_description:
How to identify original 5 mukhi Java Indonesian Rudraksha?

Some fraudulent tests have gained popularity and must be avoided because their results are unreliable and they cannot be used to determine the authenticity of Rudraksha.

The Fake tests are the Water Test, Milk test or Copper Coin Rotation Test. All these tests are unscientific and produce untrustworthy results.

One way to determine the originality of Rudraksha beads is to take an X-ray. In an X-ray, the compartment and seeds inside the Rudraksha are observable, and their number should ideally correspond to the number of Mukhi lines on the bead. Sometimes all seeds are not visible as they get compressed during formation and compartments are very close to each other, though.

Experts at Rudra Centre can examine the bead and determine if they are original or not. You can send us images and videos of your Rudraksha at the email: contact@rudracentre.com for our experts to determine authenticity.

In recent years, numerous laboratories that offer rudraksha bead certification have emerged; however, these are highly unreliable because they lack the necessary expertise and frequently make errors when identifying rudraksha beads. Numerous dealers use these laboratories to issue counterfeit certificates. These laboratories are incapable of distinguishing manipulated beads in which additional lines are engraved on the original rudraksha bead to increase its mukhi and increase its price. Additionally, they do not disregard beads with incomplete mukhi lines that do not produce results. These laboratories are not affiliated with any central organization or government, so they lack credibility.

In order to protect customers, Rudra Centre has set up its own laboratory and started giving out authentic certificates that look at all aspects of Rudraksha. We check to see if the beads are in good shape, if the mukhi lines are all there, and if the rudraksha beads have been wrought in any way.

At Rudra Centre, we issue certificates for all beads procured from us. If you want an X-ray certificate for the Rudraksha bead, then an additional INR 500 (USD 6.25) is charged per Rudraksha bead.

How to Clean & Maintain 5 mukhi Rudraksha from Java, Indonesia?

Rudraksha beads can last a lifetime and be passed down through generations if cared for properly.

In cold and dry climates, rudraksha beads may develop surface-level cracks, in which case any natural unscented oil may be applied, such as olive oil, sandal oil, or cow ghee.

Rudraksha may develop molds and insects if they are kept in a humid place and unused for a long time, in this case follow the below steps:

  • Dip the Rudraksha beads in lukewarm water for 15 mins.
  • Clean any molds visible of the surface using a toothbrush.
  • Dry them under the shade of the Sun (indirect Sunlight) or you can also use a dryer or hairdryer.
  • After following the above steps, you can start wearing your rudraksha beads or combination again.

Follow the steps below to regularly clean your Rudraksha beads:

  • Wash Rudraksha beads under running water.
  • Scrub the surface of the rudraksha to remove any dust particles caught in the grooves, using a toothbrush.
  • Use the shade of the Sun (indirect sunlight) or a hairdryer to dry the beads.
  • Apply any natural and unscented oil like Olive oil, Almond oil or Sandal oil.
  • If you are planning to not wear beads for a long duration, it is advisable to keep them in the fridge.
  • Do not use any chemical cleaner or insecticide or pesticide to clean or treat your Rudraksha.
  • Do not put your rudraksha beads in boiling water or extremely hot water.

You can watch the video

5 mukhi Java, Indonesian Rudraksha Health & Color

The 5 mukhi Java rudraksha color ranges from white to dark brown hue. This is a natural process that has no impact on the energy of the Rudraksha bead. It is ideal to choose a light sandy brown to brown Rudraksha bead, as this indicates that the bead is healthy and newly harvested. It is recommended to avoid wearing dark black or dark grey beads, as they may lack vitality. If you hear the seeds within the bead rattling, the bead is lifeless or dead; if you do not hear any rattling, the bead is healthy and alive.

You can examine the bead from all sides and look inside the natural hole to ensure no white mold or insects have infested it. Soap sometimes gets stuck around the white lines or mukhis, or inside the natural holes of the bead. To prevent these chemicals to further damage the bead, clean the bead from these as soon as possible. The energy of the Rudraksha beads resides in the seeds, so we must ensure that they are alive and healthy.
